environment.description: Same Rails 7.0 application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. PostgreSQL 15 with connection pooling via PgBouncer in transaction mode. The application connects as role 'app_service' which has SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE on relevant tables but is NOT the table owner. RLS policies are enforced via pg_catalog.pg_policies with FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY enabled on the 'accounts' and 'transfers' tables. The RLS policy on 'accounts' restricts visibility and modification to rows where accounts.tenant_id matches current_setting('app.current_tenant_id')::uuid. Additionally, a CHECK constraint on transfers enforces that source_account_id and destination_account_id must reference accounts visible under the current RLS policy (implemented via a BEFORE INSERT trigger that re-validates through a security-definer function). The ALB has a listener rule that inspects the Origin header and drops requests where Origin does not match the configured allowlist (*.internal.company.io) — implemented as a fixed-response 403 rule with priority 1 that triggers when the http-header Origin condition does NOT match 'https://*.internal.company.io'. Session cookies use SameSite=Strict.

rls_policies.transfers_tenant_isolation: USING (source_account_id IN (SELECT id FROM accounts)) WITH CHECK (source_account_id IN (SELECT id FROM accounts) AND destination_account_id IN (SELECT id FROM accounts))

config.trigger: BEFORE INSERT ON transfers validates account visibility under current RLS context
